categories.name: payment-failure
categories.description: The customer cannot complete a payment: error, timeout, hanging payment page, or money taken without a booking confirmation.

categories.name: double-charge
categories.description: The customer was charged more than once for the same booking.

categories.name: checkout-issue
categories.description: A problem in the checkout before the payment: seats, vouchers, extras.

categories.name: search-issue
categories.description: The search shows no, wrong or slow results.

categories.name: billing-request
categories.description: Invoices, receipts and refunds for cancelled trips.

categories.name: booking-change
categories.description: Changes to an existing booking: passenger name, bike, extras.

categories.name: other
categories.description: Anything that fits no other category.

priorities.name: P1
priorities.rule: Never for a single ticket. Only for a problem that affects many customers - set by OpsPilot.

priorities.name: P2
priorities.rule: The customer cannot pay or book, or has lost money.

priorities.name: P3
priorities.rule: A feature does not work, but the customer can still book.

priorities.name: P4
priorities.rule: A question, a request or feedback without current impact.
